course.title: Product Design -II
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value: A process is being controlled with a fraction non-conforming control chart. The process average has been shown to be 0.07. Three sigma control limits are used and the procedure calls for taking daily samples of 400 items.
i) Calculate the upper and lower control limits.
If the process average suddenly shift to 0.01, what is the probability that the shift would be detected on the first subsequent sample?
iii) What is the probability that the shift in part (ii) would be detected on the first and second sample taken after the shift?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
